title: ICV1 curve and ICCAN1 candidate identity

rules: trace and order are decimal integers
end is certified End(E) order discriminant or unk
level is relative to the selected ell-volcano and is certified or unk
path records root-relative certified edges with direction+prime
full canonical JSON is authoritative; slug is display-only
never identify a curve by j or order alone
candidate record embeds full curve_id and config hash
stage-only candidates leave full-DLP metrics null
